overloads.semanticRole: The Version type command returns a numeric value that denotes the type of 4D or 4D Server version that you are running.

constraints: The returned value is a bit field (see the VersionTypeBitFlag enum); use bitwise operators to interpret it (a version can be e.g. both a 64-bit version and a merged application). Not modeled as a plain enum_ref because return values are an OR-combination of these flags, not a single selected constant.

Predefined constants (4D Environment theme, VersionTypeBitFlag enum): 64 bit version = 1, Demo version = 0 (not available in current 4D versions), Merged application = 2 (version is an application merged with 4D Volume Desktop).
_needsReview: Autoparse dropped the return type entirely for this no-parentheses signature ('Version type : Integer'), a known autoparse bug for bare (no-parens) signature lines; restored via overloadPatches. TypeRef's 'concrete' kind disallows additionalProperties (no sentinelValues on a bare return type), so the bit-field constant values are documented in constraints text instead.
